description: Shell infrastructure: create BottomNavBar component and update DashboardShell, Sidebar, Header. FloatingAIChat already accounts for the bottom nav (bottom: calc(4rem + ...)) — no changes needed there.
steps: 1. CREATE src/components/layout/BottomNavBar.tsx — new component. Props: { items: NavItem[], activeTab?: string, onTabChange?: (id: string) => void, accent: string }. Render: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 z-40 h-16 bg-[#1a2035] border-t border-white/10. Visibility: `flex md:hidden` (hidden at md=768px+ where sidebar appears). Safe area: add `pb-[env(safe-area-inset-bottom)]` to the container. Show only the first 5 items from the `items` array (operator has 9; slice to 5 for bottom bar). Each item: a flex-col button with the icon (size-5) and a truncated label (text-[9px] mt-0.5 truncate). Active item: icon+text coloured with `accent`; inactive: `rgba(255,255,255,0.5)`. Tapping an item calls onTabChange(item.id). Export as named export. Import NavItem type from './Sidebar'.

2. MODIFY src/components/layout/DashboardShell.tsx — (a) Import BottomNavBar from './BottomNavBar'. (b) In the JSX, add `<BottomNavBar items={nav} activeTab={activeTab} onTabChange={onTabChange} accent={accent} />` after `<FloatingAIChat />` inside the outer div. (c) On `<main>`, add `pb-16 md:pb-0` to its className so content is never hidden behind the bottom nav. (d) Change page-header `px-6 py-4` to `px-4 sm:px-6 py-3 sm:py-4`. (e) Change h1 `text-xl font-bold` to `text-base sm:text-xl font-bold`. (f) Change the live-status pill `flex` to `hidden sm:flex`. (g) Change inner content area `p-6` to `p-3 sm:p-6`.

3. MODIFY src/components/layout/Sidebar.tsx — No CSS changes required. The aside already uses `hidden lg:flex` which correctly hides it on mobile and tablet. Confirm this is still correct after reading the current file — it is, per our exploration.

4. MODIFY src/components/layout/Header.tsx — (a) Change the BHURAKSHAK title span from `text-sm` to `text-[11px] sm:text-sm` to give more header room on 320px screens. (b) Change the 'Prototype · demo data' badge from `hidden md:inline` to `hidden lg:inline` to reclaim horizontal space on tablets where the sidebar is also hidden. The role label badge stays `hidden sm:inline-flex`.
acceptance_criteria: BottomNavBar renders at the bottom of the screen on viewports below 768px
BottomNavBar is hidden (not rendered) at 768px and above
Active nav item in BottomNavBar is highlighted with the role accent colour
Tapping a nav item in BottomNavBar switches the active tab
Page content is not hidden behind the BottomNavBar (pb-16 on main)
FloatingAIChat button still sits above the BottomNavBar
Header does not overflow or clip on 320px width
npm run build exits 0 with no TypeScript errors
